newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Rifkind brings forward Cyprus visit.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Rifkind brings forward Cyprus visit.

text.p: British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind will start a planned two-day visit to Cyprus on Sunday rather than Monday because of a crucial parliamentary vote, Foreign Office officials said on Friday.
Rifkind is due to visit Cyprus with special British envoy Sir David Hannay in a bid to persuade the island's Turkish and Greek communities to start talks on ending a decades-old conflict.
The visit was moved forward a day to allow Rifkind to be in the British parliament late on Monday for a vote on the European Union's fisheries policy.
The British government has lost its overall majority in the lower chamber and wants to avoid a repeat of last year's vote on the policy, which resulted in an embarrassing defeat.
